articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones strike St. Petersburg and three Russian regions, injuring three and disrupting flights
articles.lead_en: A Ukrainian drone attack injured three people in Novorossiysk, Krasnodar Krai, the regional emergency response headquarters said. Windows were blown out in an apartment building, and fires broke out in two private houses because of “debris falling.”

articles.title_en: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill two in Kharkiv and injure seven in Kyiv
articles.lead_en: Russian forces fired a missile at Kyiv in the early hours of November 26, wounding seven people, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said. Doctors described the condition of two of the injured as serious.
